notes: Independent targeted spotcheck of nine preview records; page access denotes live official page read, not an independent institutional or scientific quality endorsement. Geographic checks are bounded to listed official bases and do not infer worldwide eligibility from scope. The PAHO duplicate present at the initial snapshot was reported and the parent reports the pipeline corrected it.

findings.fees: Guidelines and ethics state no fees at any stage, including submission, page and publication fees.
findings.ai: Ethics 1.7 addresses AI writing, collection and analysis under human oversight and disclosure; drafting and analysis are supported in context, with human accountability. Guidelines require a methods or declaration statement beyond basic proofreading.
findings.geography: Ethics cites Brazilian jurisdiction; that is not alone proof of a venue office or publisher address. Worldwide fee eligibility is explicit, not proof of an unrestricted submission policy.

findings.fees: Editorial policy explicitly covers submission, processing and publication without charge for authors worldwide.
findings.ai: Journal expressly permits research and writing, data analysis and software assistance, including heavily revised drafts; declaration and human validation apply. Submission checklist sets an additional 12% AI-generated-text limit.
findings.geography: Policy expressly invites authors worldwide. Institution geography was not independently rechecked in this bounded pass.

findings.fees: IOP explicitly says no submission charge; journal says sponsor currently pays all publication charges, so no author publication fees. The video abstract is requested after acceptance; the page warns missing it delays publication, but states no production fee.
findings.ai: IOP explicitly permits research ideation, simulation, analysis and code generation and critically revised generated text. Material AI contribution requires a separate acknowledgement statement and research use also in methods.
findings.geography: Co-publishing institution in China and UK IOP publisher are distinct; headquarters is not an author-location rule.
findings.recommended_correction: Add IOP's explicit prohibition on generating or modifying reference lists, while distinguishing allowed literature discovery, citation management and formatting, to restrictions; clarify that basic language editing is exempt only when not material.

findings.fees: Journal submission policy and about page specify no submission or publication charges; public repository and DOI archive requirements do not establish a mandatory paid service.
findings.ai: AI is allowed for most aspects including software creation, code generation and paper drafting; authors disclose tools, scope and validation. No AI in editorial/reviewer conversation except translation.
findings.geography: Open Journals says it is online-only and has no physical office; NumFOCUS is a US fiscal sponsor and correspondence address, not automatically a publisher headquarters or journal location.
findings.recommended_correction: Represent NumFOCUS explicitly as US fiscal host/correspondence address, not as an established Open Journals publisher country; retain venue location unknown.

findings.fees: Official instructions explicitly state no submission fees or APCs. Historical official society announcement also says no page charges; check contemporary page-limit conditions.
findings.ai: INFORMS explicitly permits manuscript preparation, citing drafting and data analysis, and requires acknowledgements disclosure. Analysis covers the campaign's analytical assistance criterion; no inference of unrestricted autonomous analysis.
findings.geography: Society/publisher office is a stated society basis, not an author residency restriction; location was not independently rechecked in this pass.
findings.recommended_correction: Replace the inaccessible PDF-only AI citation with the official author-portal text when retrievable; retain search-snippet access honestly until full policy is read.

findings.fees: Journal about page expressly says publication has no cost for authors and diamond model has no researcher fees; full instructions accessible by ordinary direct HTTPS.
findings.ai: Instructions address research design, data collection, interpretation and manuscript preparation with disclosure and independent validation; code assistance is an inference from the broader research policy, not explicitly named. Assess the actual workflow accordingly.
findings.geography: Official instructions identify PAHO as owner and Washington DC as its headquarters. Americas research remit does not establish an author residence restriction.
findings.recommended_correction: Keep only one bilingual PAHO journal record; the initially observed reversed-name duplicate was reported to the parent and parent reports pipeline deduplication.

findings.fees: Official call explicitly rules out submission, processing, publication, page, colour and withdrawal fees.
findings.ai: Policy addresses text, code, data and analysis and requires disclosure and human verification; substantially human intellectual contribution is required. The detailed policy regulates substantive use rather than limiting authors to editing.
findings.geography: Venue and publisher location must follow the actual journal ownership and contact evidence, not the general legal or international scope; not independently rechecked here.

findings.fees: About page expressly states neither submission charges nor APCs and publishing completely free. Initial concern sent to parent was withdrawn after full section read.
findings.ai: Journal discusses responsible research use, writing and summarising and AI in generation or analysis of data/software; human ideas, interpretations and conclusions are required. Disclose writing tools in methods and contributing generative AI in a Use of AI section and cover letter.
findings.geography: Official contact page is in Delft, Netherlands; this is a journal contact location and does not itself affirm author eligibility worldwide.

findings.fees: Editorial policy says it imposes no fees or payments on authors.
findings.ai: General-purpose assistive use is explicitly permitted; FAQ permits writing assistance and requires first-page disclosure. It expects ideas, claims and results to be human-sourced. Applying broad assistive permission to analytical coding is a reasoned interpretation with that material limitation, not an explicit code-specific permission.
findings.geography: No verified physical journal address established from these pages; online and international scope alone do not prove a country or eligibility rule.
findings.recommended_correction: Label analytical-code permission as interpretation of broad general-purpose assistance and prominently preserve the human-sourced ideas, claims and results limitation.
